name: Kinetica 1
location_str: Launch Area 130 @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: 5 launches from Launch Area 130 so far this year. 15 in total since it opened.
slot_b_text: CAS Space's 6th launch of the year, 17th all time. 5th from Launch Area 130 this year, 58 days since the last one. The 228th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
rocket_fact: Kinetica-1 is built by CAS Space, a spinoff of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
